notes: The design lays its right side out for a flank unwrapped like the Tatuus's,
flipped both ways. This car flips its right flank top to bottom only, so
these are the left side's rects flipped the way this car is.
The number goes on the rear quarter, the largest panel of each side, and
so did the sponsors, onto it. They move to the door, below the name.
